records.authority: Primary for the September 10 release, product scope, connections, permissions, workflow and availability claims.
passages: OpenAI dated the release September 10, 2026 and introduced the Data agent in ChatGPT Work.

OpenAI says it connects to approved sources including Amazon Redshift, Datadog, Google BigQuery, ClickHouse, Databricks, MongoDB and Snowflake, and can also use files and documents from Google Drive and SharePoint.
OpenAI says it uses an organization's business terms, metric definitions, custom calculations and data relationships from semantic layers and trusted sources to interpret data.
OpenAI says enterprise administrators choose which data connections and roles are available, while queries enforce the connected account's existing table, row and column permissions.
OpenAI says users can ask follow-up questions and review the evidence behind findings, then build, edit, share and refresh interactive dashboards.
OpenAI says the agent can recommend next steps, share findings through Slack or email, and carry out actions the user approves through connected tools.
OpenAI says the Data plugin appears in the Plugins directory in ChatGPT Work; administrators can install it, configure relevant data-source plugins and manage who can use them.
records.limitation: Feature, internal-adoption and customer-result descriptions are vendor claims. The release supplies no public accuracy benchmark and no new standalone price.

records.authority: Primary for OpenAI's current business-data training, encryption and access-control statements.
passages: OpenAI says it does not use data from its listed business products, including inputs and outputs, for training or improving models by default.
OpenAI says business data is encrypted at rest and in transit between customers, OpenAI and its service providers.
OpenAI lists role-based controls for ChatGPT Work, connected tools and workspace agents among Enterprise features.
records.limitation: These are OpenAI's stated platform commitments. An organization still has to check its exact plan, retention, data residency, connected-source and employer-policy requirements.

records.authority: Primary current documentation for workspace plugin access, read/write action controls and approval settings.
passages: OpenAI's help page says app access controls who can use a connected app, actions control what it can do, and permissions control when ChatGPT asks before using it.
Administrators can separately enable supported read and write actions and set whether future actions are enabled.
The documented permission choices include always ask, allow read actions, allow low-risk actions and, where supported for an individual app, allow all actions.
OpenAI says provider approval, OAuth scopes and ChatGPT action settings are separate checks.
records.limitation: Exact options depend on workspace, role and app. This source does not establish which settings any reader's employer has chosen.

records.authority: Independent reporting based on an interview with OpenAI's enterprise technology lead; primary for what the reporter asked and what OpenAI disclosed about external evaluation.
passages: VentureBeat reported on September 10 that the Data agent connects to enterprise data sources and turns findings into dashboards, recommendations and follow-up actions.
OpenAI told VentureBeat that the product stitches existing context together at use time rather than creating a new persistent context layer.
VentureBeat reported that OpenAI has not published a retrieval-accuracy or correctness benchmark for the external Data agent product.

The report says OpenAI described an internal comparison against its own data tools but did not provide a published number; VentureBeat characterized that as an internal comparison rather than an independently verified benchmark.
VentureBeat concluded that the shift does not remove the need for data engineering because access controls and audit trails still need maintenance.
records.limitation: The article is reporting and analysis, not a hands-on evaluation of Data agent outputs or an independent product benchmark.
